ModMetaData.name: Drafted Command Priority
ModMetaData.author: Allen / Rimworld-Project
ModMetaData.description: V0.2 Absolute Player Authority. Any player-issued job immediately takes control from the pawn's current AI/job state and remains authoritative until the current and queued player-forced commands are finished. Burning, fleeing, combat warmup, hauling, rescue, work and other autonomous jobs cannot veto or replace a player command. Hard incapacity is the only exception: dead/downed pawns, stun, or temporary despawn/flyer knockback cannot be forcibly commanded until control returns. Shift queues behind an existing player command chain; if AI currently owns the pawn, the first Shift order still takes control immediately. Optional drafted melee auto-attack remains available and never interrupts a player-command chain. RimWorld 1.5.
